source: nflverse play-by-play (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) and participation (2023, 2024, 2025) data, github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data, CC-BY-4.0. Regular seasons. Built by `npm run pipeline -- matchups`.

threeSafetyShare.note: Share of nickel (5 DB) and dime (6 DB) snaps where three or more of the defensive backs are safeties.

expectedPoints.note: Mean nflverse expected points by down | distance to go (1-10, 11-14, 15+) | yards-to-goal band (index = floor((yards to goal - 1) / 5)).
